reviews.title: Great app but ridiculous price increase
reviews.text: The app works wonders for helping to unwind and get a good nights sleep. The sad part is that a yearly membership was around £25-£30, and now they’re asking for £70! Such a shame.

reviews.title: Creators please sell this app
reviews.text: After over a year with no new updates, I wish the creators would just sell this app to someone else who would actually develop it. (Calm app, I’m tagging you in). It’s such a great concept but obviously limiting bc you’ll never have any more new sleepscapes. Irritating to see the social ads constantly.

reviews.title: UPDATE???
reviews.text: Really had enjoyed Loona. So relaxing and really visually beautiful.  Only complaint is that they need more escapes. Coming up on the end of my second year this January ‘27. Haven’t seen a new Escape in over 8 months. Beware. Developers don’t seem concerned about updating this app.

reviews.title: Where are the new updates?!
reviews.text: I love this app and use it everyday whether it be music in background, escapes before bed or a quick escape when anxiety hits. No new escapes have been added in a year and I have now cancelled the subscription now as it’s been too long I with no new updates or escapes

reviews.title: Развод
reviews.text: Купил подписку на сайте на год, активировать не могу, поддержка не отвечает

reviews.title: Claims 3 day trial, charges immediately
reviews.text: If I could give 0 stars I would. I agreed to and signed up for a 3 day free trial. I am on an extremely tight budget but wanted to see if it was helpful then I would save up the $99.99 annual charge. They charged me immediately. It did not clear because like I said I would have to save up for it if it was helpful. Now my Apple account is in limbo. I can’t do anything until I put in new payment information then fight them for a refund. They do not respond to their contact email, social media dm’s/comments or other reviews. I watched the first night because I thought I was on a trial and I have not used it sense because I do not want that used against me. I actually found it helpful but they scammed me.

reviews.title: Not worth it anymore
reviews.text: I used this app for a while a few years back, when I was using it I’m pretty sure it cost about half what it costs now for the yearly subscription. I got rid of it because they hadn’t added content in a while and I figured I would pick it back up again in the future once they had added content. However I downloaded the app again recently and I’m not sure there’s a single thing that has been added in the last few years… but the price has doubled. The concept of this app is great but it almost feels like it’s been abandoned by the developers. Unfortunately I’m not willing to pay what it cost these days for essentially no new content.

reviews.title: Everything is now Locked behind a Paywall
reviews.text: Stopped playing for a bit due to my hyperfixation moving. When I come back, I find every escape I haven’t played locked behind Loona plus. I wouldn’t have rated so low even with that if it wasn’t for the fact that it costs nearly $20 a month. Just make the app pay to play at that point. Scammers.

reviews.title: Don’t download unless you have money
reviews.text: Loved the first night helped me go to sleep. Tonight no…immediately wanted me to pay 20$…what happened to apps that actually wanted to help people, downloads should be enough revenue…

reviews.title: Lovely,but not as great.
reviews.text:
i do love this app and i love the sleep scapes but i know you get 50% off which is great but you only get to look at 2 sleepscapes and then you have to pay to see more ? I thought they’d let you look at some but not only 2.
edit: i did this review in about 2023 and i’ve come across the app again to reminisce, now you only get one free sleepscape. it’s honestly sad that we have to pay to have some peace at night , unfortunately. would be nicer if this app becomes free one day.

reviews.title: Really screwed up subscribing
reviews.text: I signed up for the free trail and the next day they charged my 100$ for the subscription. This is not only ridiculous cause the free trail was like 10 days but it also automatically signed me up for the most expensive option. There are like 20 different options to choose from and none of them explain the differences between the services. It is freaking ridiculous! I would give negative stars if I could and there is no way to contact anyone. Just an email on there website.

reviews.title: Exactly when did the developers abandon this app?
reviews.text:
I used to be a long time subscriber and used to do the sleepscapes or music every night but they stopped updating the app at least 3 years ago. 

I would have appreciated a response when I suggested a playlist feature for stories as I thought it would be a great update to the app, & make the stories more useable.

I guess when they stopped updating the content, they wouldn’t address any requests for new features either.

reviews.title: Too expensive
reviews.text: It’s a great app but it’s really expensive and hasn’t been updated for a while. It seems unreasonable to charge £19.99 a month for something that isn’t being developed any more.

reviews.title: Impossible to cancel
reviews.text: Buy this app with caution—they make it impossible to cancel and before you know it, you’ve been paying $40 a month after you thought you’d already cancelled long ago. And their AI chat bot is zero help when trying to fix it.

reviews.title: !! DO NOT SUBSCRIBE!!
reviews.text: The creators of the app have went ghost and stopped creating sleepscapes over a year ago. The ones that are on the app are great but nothing new has been done and no word of it ever will. Don’t waste your money.

reviews.title: What a wasted opportunity
reviews.text: I loved this app and subscribed since the beginning. It has helped so much with sleeping and is so immersive and beautiful. The responses to reviews are frustrating as they say it will be passed along but really it would be nice to just have some transparency as to if there will ever be anything new?or if the intention of the company is to only focus on their other ventures in Apple Vision Pro, Meta Quest XR and Animation Inc. For an app marketed toward mental health it is very disappointing that the company is happy to leave it’s customers in limbo with no information while continuing to take our money to invest in other projects. If there was any sign of things changing I would be back, however it seems that Loona Inc, their founders and parent companies are happy to use the wellness space for gain while it suits but leaves people hanging when there is a better offer.

reviews.title: don't be fooled
reviews.text: they can tout "#1 app", but too bad they don't specify when... I'm thinking >3 years ago. don't get me wrong, the app is nice/fun & does calm the mind to induce sleep. however. it costs $40/year and they are not updating this app. obviously that's asinine. they haven't updated it in over a year. so once you've done all of the picture-scapes, there's nothing more, just disappointment.

reviews.title: Why does it cost so much
reviews.text: Greedy world can’t even enjoy this app

reviews.title: Stopped updating content
reviews.text: Once you get through the limited content that is it. No new content in years.

reviews.title: Nothing new
reviews.text: I have been a member for many years, but you have not added any new escapes in years. When are you adding more content?

reviews.title: This app is no longer updated-NO NEW CONTENT
reviews.text: This used to be my favorite app. It helped me fall asleep five times faster than I normally would, and I had no issue paying the subscription fee because of how much it benefitted me. Then after some time, the developers went silent and clearly abandoned this app. Is this my issue? Not at all. Projects come and go and not everything can last forever, but what’s absolutely disgusting to me is that this app is SUBSCRIPTION BASED with ZERO new content having been added in so long. And the price is outrageous for limited content—$70 PER YEAR? Are you kidding me?!Maybe if there were regular updates, but for something that hasn’t been touched in forever, the developers are out of their minds charging so much for an app that went cold more than a year ago.

reviews.title: Too expensive for lack of content
reviews.text: I loved loona for a couple months and then ran out of stories to do. Not worth $70 a year.

reviews.title: Makes me pay for everything, not a good sleep app, a disaster!
reviews.text: This app was recommended to me by a friend, and they told me it was free. So did the App Store! All it said was in app purchases! Well, they were wrong, because after only doing one sleep escape, it started trying to charge me money for doing literally anything! This app is high key the worst if your broke like me so if u don’t got money, don’t get it! Js read a book or something to go to sleep. Not worth the money. It is useful tho, once you pay for it. It really does help me go to sleep but that is literally the only good thing abt it.

reviews.title: Annoyed and Disappointed
reviews.text: Why are we paying such an crazy amount for a subscription to use an app that hasn’t been updated in years? No new content or scenes EVER and you expect us to pay that much? For reference I have been paying for and using this app since it was first put out but it’s not worth it anymore with no more updates so I’ve canceled. Disappointed because the app has the makings to be great if it hadn’t been forgotten about by creators!!

reviews.title: DO NOT GET YEARLY SUBSCRIPTION
reviews.text:
My original review was 5 stars, I loved this app and used it every night. I even purchased a whole year of premium to be able to access all parts of the app. It was such a scam - they claim to do monthly updates to stories and scapes which is a straight up lie. any update they made during the year+ long subscription i had was just minor bug fixes. no new stories or scapes as promised. so shady. i would have saved my money and just bought the 3 month subscription, but the deal they flash to get a discount is extremely predatory - especially because at this point there is no way the employees are unaware of these bad practices. 

They also love to hide bad reviews, but please notice the 4 star reviews all say the same. a lot of people had to go back to their original review and edit it like me. 

After about 3 months, I went through every piece of content MULTIPLE times - to the point where it no longer worked to help me sleep, because I had listened to each story so many times already. The stories were really the main reason I got the premium, and now that I no longer use this app, I am not surprised to see they have not added new content in over a year. A whole year - during your annual membership, that means not getting ANY new content. Insane.

 I wish i had just gotten a 2 month subscription, but they rope you into the annual one by giving you a "special offer." DO NOT do it - the app has not released ANY new stories or sound scapes in literally 5 years. they ignore custom

reviews.text: How about I see if I like this THEN I share my personal account info?  I don’t get why a so called free trail needs my info first as if to say you don’t have confidence in their own product so let’s put a hook in the mouth first.  Give me three days first then ask

reviews.title: Abandoned??
reviews.text: I love this app but it seems to have been abandoned! No updates for eight months and its been two years since a new colouring level was released. Ive paid a lot of money to it over the years and its a shame! Would be very supportive of them continuing to update it. For people who use daily the stories and colouring pages get very repetitive. Hope they update soon.

reviews.title: Recent price increase is ridiculous
reviews.text: An amazing app with a truly unique feel and benefits - until the developers upped the price to be completely unaffordable. £20 a MONTH? It used to be £30/40 for an entire year. I’m a long term user of the app and used to tell everyone about it, but this is just so disappointing and will loose them a lot of customers. Please consider affordable pricing again

reviews.title: Used to be amazing - now they have abandoned it
reviews.text: I used this app all the time, but it seems that they have just abandoned it. No new sleepscapes in over a year, the subscription fee is too expensive with no new content being added. I have been a long term subscriber but I have cancelled my subscription. A shame as I really loved this app.

reviews.title: Abandoned game
reviews.text: Honestly, I would have given you 5 stars if you didn’t abandon your game without telling your costumers who were still paying a subscription. I’ve done all the sleepscapes. Nothing has been updated for years, and yet they still advertise the app. I’ve tried contacting them many times and no answer. It’s a lovely app but don’t pay for it because there is no point. Just use what you can out of it.

reviews.title: Become a waste of money
reviews.text: I’ve used loona for year and it’s wonderful, if you’ve just stumbled across it it’s worth doing you’ll be able to do all the sleepscapes for the first time. Unfortunately the company don’t seem to be making any new content, it’s been over a year since they released a new sleepscape, and have stopped responding to anyone on their social media page about when new content will be released, if ever. Most people just want to know if the company has closed down or if it’s worth checking back in in a few months as they will have updated the content. My subscription has come to an end, and having raised the subscription from £20 a year to £50 without a new sleepscape a month which was originally promised, it’s simply unaffordable. It’s a real shame as this really was an amazing app with a fantastic USP. So many people feel let down.
